desc: Every day is a mission, and the Siege 15L Sling is ready to rise to any occasion. Every pocket, every strap, every zipper is purpose-driven and ready to tackle your challenges head-on. Crafted from a lightweight yet resilient 330D exterior, this water-resistant ally stands by you through rain or shine. Gear up to Siege Your Mission, Siege Your Day, Siege Your Life with the Siege 15L Sling.
